sources.title: boltuix/NeuroBERT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NeuroBERT was evaluated on a masked language modeling task using 10 IoT-related sentences. The model predicts the top-5 tokens for each masked word, and a test passes if the expected word is in the top-5 predictions.

sources.title: NeuroBERT Open-source Natural Language Processing Model - Suitable for ...
sources.snippet: NeuroBERT is an advanced lightweight natural language processing model, optimized based on google/bert-base-uncased, designed for real-time inference on resource-constrained devices. Its quantized size is only ~57MB, making it suitable for mobile applications, wearable devices, microcontrollers, and smart home devices.

sources.title: Neurobert NER | Models - AI Models
sources.snippet: NeuroBERT-NER is a transformer-based model optimized for named entity recognition (NER) tasks. It is built on top of the BERT architecture and enhanced with domain-specific adaptations for accurate entity extraction from text. NeuroBERT‑NER is fine-tuned on the CoNLL-2025 NER dataset, enabling it to identify entities such as persons, organizations, locations, and more, with high precision ...
